stem: What is the impact of lines 25 through 34 in the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride”?

options.label: A
options.text: They establish the dangers involved in making the ride.

options.label: B
options.text: They reveal the arrogance beneath Sybil’s modest exterior.

options.label: C
options.text: They shift the Colonel’s attitude from skeptical to enthusiastic.

options.label: D
options.text: They contribute to the idea that children are rebellious by nature.
